Gender: gender of the call center client
Education: highest education level achieved by the client
Governorate: governorate or administrative region where the client resides
Aware_151: whether the client is aware of service 151
Call_151: whether the client has called service 151
The_reason_of_the_call: primary reason for the client's call to the call center
Call_center_employee_communication_skill: client's rating of the call center employee's communication skills
Satisfaction_with_the_doctors_response: client's satisfaction level with the doctor's response
How_often_do_you_receive_call_center_new: frequency with which the client receives call center news updates
